# SPECTER SDR

SPECTER SDR is multi-receiver SDR software for Windows. It coordinates one to eight RTL-SDR, LimeSDR, bladeRF, or remote rtl_tcp receivers for array scanning, spectrum and waterfall analysis, live decoding, SigMF IQ capture and replay, ADS-B tracking, recording, remote rtl_tcp receivers, and network output.

- Product: https://specter-sdr.com/
- Download: https://specter-sdr.com/download
- Help Center: https://specter-sdr.com/help/
- Supported Radios: https://specter-sdr.com/help/supported-radios
- Decoder Lab: https://specter-sdr.com/help/decoder-lab
- Signal Visualizers: https://specter-sdr.com/help/visualizers
- Multi-Receiver SDR Software: https://specter-sdr.com/multi-receiver-sdr-software
- Frequency Manager and Array Scanner: https://specter-sdr.com/help/frequency-scanner
- IQ Capture and Remote Receivers: https://specter-sdr.com/help/iq-remote
- Decoder and Signal Intelligence: https://specter-sdr.com/help/signal-intelligence
- Network Output and External Control: https://specter-sdr.com/help/network-output
- ADS-B Aircraft Monitoring: https://specter-sdr.com/help/adsb
- Pricing: $199 USD one-time license
